text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I have my perfect timetable and hours of dedicated training to thank for this success.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Flawless plans naturally bring upon success. I'm glad I believed in this idea and devoted myself to it.
choice_data_list: Let's set our sights even higher.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I wish to begin building a schedule for my next race without delay.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I will prove once again that with a perfect plan comes yet another victory!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Indeed. We cannot rest on our laurels just yet.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: This victory is but a checkpoint en route to an even greater goal…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I intend to work even harder from now on to maintain my winning streak.
